provenance: PR #60 R11, second shape and a second code path: `_nearest` reaches `near.strip()` before any `_whole_string(near)` lambda is called, so a non-string `near` raised `AttributeError: 'float' object has no attribute 'strip'` and classified `act`. Guarding inside `_whole_string` could never have covered this one; guarding at the top of `resolve()` does.

triage.note: Two shapes, two mechanisms — locator construction before the guard (`name`) and string manipulation before the guard (`near`). The third measured shape, a LIST-valued `name`, is the same mechanism as the first and is covered by `resolver-non-string-name-is-a-list`.
